catalog.summary: Acquisitions Manager: turns owner goals into lead research assignments, tracks each lead through a pipeline, and drafts outreach for owner approval.
catalog.longDescription: Manages a real-estate acquisitions pipeline on top of RealtyLeadsAI. Assigns bounded research briefs to the Lead Research Analyst, adds each delivered lead to a pipeline card, moves leads through New, Qualified, Outreach planned, Contacted, Negotiating and Closed or Dead on the owner's instruction, drafts outreach letters as documents for approval, and reports status each management cycle. It never contacts leads or changes provider records.
